policy_denials.detail: git status --short | head; ls crates/athena-cli/tests; grep -n "specialization" -r crates docs/spec.toml CHANGELOG.md | head -40; grep -n -A8 'OLY-B-NOTE-01' docs/spec.toml

grep -n "^use" crates/athena-core/src/snapshot.rs; grep -n "pub use\|specialization\|mod planning" crates/athena-core/src/status.rs | head -20; sed -n 180,215p crates/athena-cli/src/display.rs; cat crates/athena-cli/tests/common/mod.rs | grep -n "pub fn\|pub struct" | head -30; grep -n "status_snapshot\|status_role_need" xtask/shard-timings.txt
cargo test -p athena-cli --test routing_evidence 2>&1 | grep -v Compiling
cargo fmt --all --check 2>&1; echo fmt=$?; cargo test -p xtask --test policy 2>&1; cargo test -p athena-cli --test mirrors 2>&1; cargo test -p xtask --test ci_shards 2>&1
